name: cargo-semver-checks
mechanism: 双版本rustdoc JSON+Trustfall查询diff；700+lint(2026-09索引口径)；库API Check/SemverQuery/QueryOverride可内嵌

name: cargo-public-api
mechanism: rustdoc JSON枚举公开API+diff模式对基线；与semver-checks共享快照管线

name: rustdoc JSON格式
mechanism: unstable(-Z unstable-options)；rustdoc-types跟踪FORMAT_VERSION；快照元数据须记格式版本，不匹配降级SKIP

name: trycmd
mechanism: 枚举.trycmd/.md/.toml用例；TRYCMD=dump/overwrite三段流；占位符(...)、[EXE]、[ROOT]省略动态值；fs.sandbox副作用比对

name: buf breaking
mechanism: 四类阶梯FILE/PACKAGE/WIRE_JSON/WIRE(2026-10-03官方文档)；删除类+同值类+UNLESS_*_RESERVED豁免；选档锁档哲学

name: oasdiff
mechanism: 变更类别枚举(470+/755两种口径)+breaking/non-breaking severity+deprecation宽限期；PR action门

name: libabigail/abidiff
mechanism: DWARF/CTF/BTF重建ABI；abignore抑制文件豁免；abipkgdiff有害/无害分级；2.7/2.8于2025发布

name: cbindgen
mechanism: syn语法树生成C/C++头文件；头文件入库+git diff=FFI表面门；注释标注控制导出

name: cargo-msrv+MSRV resolver
mechanism: rust-version字段(Cargo 1.56起)+MSRV-aware resolver(Cargo 1.84,resolver v3 fallback默认)+工具链二分实测verify

name: doctest(rustdoc/mdBook)
mechanism: 示例编译为独立crate执行；compile_fail反例判据；mdbook test复用rustdoc(mdBook维护模式)

name: Rust ABI稳定性现状
mechanism: 无跨编译器版本稳定ABI(Reference ABI章口径)；repr(C)/extern C为边界内稳定通道

name: semverver
mechanism: rustc插件式semver检查；更新滞后于现代rustc，被cargo-semver-checks路线取代

name: cargo-breaking
mechanism: 源码静态分析公开项再比对版本(与rustdoc JSON数据流不同路)；semver-checks不满足时回看

name: cargo-smart-release
mechanism: semver感知发布自动化(bump建议/changelog)；ADV发布流程设计时回看

name: abi-compliance-checker
mechanism: C/C++源级+二进制级ABI dump报告；与abidiff二选一优先libabigail；Debian 2025-11仍有更新

name: snapbox/insta-cmd/expect-test
mechanism: CLI快照其他路线：snapbox(trycmd底座,单点定制)/insta-cmd/expect-test内联快照

name: gorelease
mechanism: 对比上一版本API自动建议下一semver版本号(x/exp,BSD)；diff→版本号自动化思路

name: semver 0.x陷阱与pinning
mechanism: Cargo 0.x特殊兼容规则(0.2.3~0.2.4兼容,0.3.0不兼容)；npm/Go口径不同；区间+锁文件双轨写入版本政策

name: #deprecated废弃通道
mechanism: #[deprecated(since,note)]：since锚+编译警告传播+标记→删除阶梯；未废弃即删=breaking(与buf UNLESS_*_RESERVED同构,旧仓编号断档教训机制化)

name: cargo-semver-checks自定义规则限制
mechanism: 运行时不支持自定义lint集(维护者2024-01口径)；0.50.0公开库API可内嵌/调严重级,新增查询仍需编译期进入
